card.name: Digits in German phone numbers
card.fires_on: Digits inside German telephone numbers, right after the +49 country code and in the area code (e.g. 761, 6221, 711). Also fires on digits in German postal codes and report numbers.

modes.label: Area code after +49
modes.description: A digit in the area code following +49 in a German contact line.

modes.label: Other German numbers
modes.description: Digits in German postal codes or report numbers tied to German institutions.

card.writes: It promotes place names such as Chinese provinces and Portuguese, and suppresses German, Germany and Berlin, so it pushes against naming Germany next.
card.plain: It marks the digits of a German phone number or area code, mostly in press contact lines.
